fields.title: Array Data Structure & Algorithmic Patterns Quiz
fields.description: Master array memory layouts, 2-pointers, prefix sums, sliding window arrays, and multidimensional arrays from basic to advanced.

fields.title: String Processing & Pattern Matching Algorithms Quiz
fields.description: Master string immutability, pattern matching (KMP, Rabin-Karp, Z-algorithm), palindromic expansions, string building, and text parsing.

fields.title: Pointers, Memory Allocation & Address Arithmetic Quiz
fields.description: Master memory addresses, pointer arithmetic, double pointers, reference safety, heap vs stack memory, dynamic allocation, and memory leaks.

fields.title: Recursion, Backtracking & Recurrence Relations Quiz
fields.description: Master call stack frames, base cases, tail recursion, state space trees, divide and conquer, Master Theorem, and backtracking pruning.

fields.title: Singly, Doubly & Circular Linked List Master Quiz
fields.description: Master dynamic node pointers, 3-pointer reversals, Floyd's cycle detection, fast/slow middle pointer, skip lists, and memory fragmentation.

fields.title: Stack Data Structure & Monotonic Stack Applications Quiz
fields.description: Master LIFO invariants, call stack execution, expression evaluation (Shunting-Yard), monotonic stacks, min stack, and histogram area.

fields.title: Queue, Circular Queue & Priority Queue Systems Quiz
fields.description: Master FIFO scheduling buffers, circular modulo index arithmetic, priority queues, monotonic deques, double-ended queues, and multi-source BFS.

fields.title: Sliding Window & Two Pointer Techniques Quiz
fields.description: Master fixed vs dynamic window bounds, inward two pointers, fast/slow pointers, frequency map windows, and exact count reductions.

fields.title: General Trees & Tree Traversals Master Quiz
fields.description: Master tree terminology, height vs depth, DFS (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder), BFS Level-Order, path sums, diameter, and tree construction.

fields.title: Binary Tree Architecture & Properties Quiz
fields.description: Master binary tree properties, complete vs full vs perfect trees, vertical order, top/bottom views, LCA, and subtree invariants.

fields.title: Binary Search Tree Invariants & Operations Quiz
fields.description: Master BST search, insert, delete (3 cases), inorder sorting property, BST validation, LCA in BST, floor/ceil, and Kth smallest element.

fields.title: AVL Trees & Self-Balancing Rotations Quiz
fields.description: Master balance factor invariant (-1, 0, 1), single rotations (LL, RR), double rotations (LR, RL), insertion/deletion rebalancing, and AVL height bounds.

fields.title: Min-Heap, Max-Heap & Priority Queue Operations Quiz
fields.description: Master heap invariants (Min-Heap, Max-Heap), array representation, Heapify (O(N)), Heap Sort, Priority Queues, K-way merges, and median streams.

fields.title: Graph Algorithms, Shortest Paths & Topological Sort Quiz
fields.description: Master Adjacency List/Matrix, BFS, DFS, Cycle Detection, Topological Sort (Kahn's), Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, Kruskal/Prim MST, and Tarjan SCC.

fields.title: Dynamic Programming (DP) & State Transitions Quiz
fields.description: Master optimal substructure, overlapping subproblems, top-down memoization, bottom-up tabulation, 1D/2D DP, Knapsack variants, LCS, and Bitmask DP.
